description: Conservation of Nvj3 cavity-lining residues across 185 fungal PXA-only orthologs, with burial-matched control
code:
exec(open("cavity_tools_src.py").read(), globals())
import json, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats

D=json.load(open("nvj3_pairwise_maps.json")); maps=D["maps"]; ref=D["ref"]
seqs=json.load(open("nvj3like_seqs.json"))
N=len(ref); K=len(maps); print("orthologs used:",K)
HYD=set("AVLIMFWCY")
ident=np.zeros(N); hydfrac=np.zeros(N); cov=np.zeros(N); ent=np.zeros(N)
cols=[[] for _ in range(N)]
for k,m in maps.items():
    s=seqs[k]; m=np.array(m)
    for i in range(N):
        if m[i]>=0: cols[i].append(s[m[i]])
for i in range(N):
    c=cols[i]; cov[i]=len(c)/K
    if not c: continue
    ident[i]=np.mean([x==ref[i] for x in c])
    hydfrac[i]=np.mean([x in HYD for x in c])
    _,cnt=np.unique(list(c),return_counts=True); p=cnt/cnt.sum(); ent[i]=-np.sum(p*np.log2(p))

# cavity lining residues (psp>=6 top cavity of Nvj3 PXA module)
at=subset(parse_pdb("struct/NVJ3_yeast.pdb"),61,253)
pk=find_pockets(at, psp_min=6)
lining=set(pk[0]["lining_resi"]); print("cavity volume %.0f A^3, lining residues n=%d"%(pk[0]["volume"],len(lining)))

# burial proxy: heavy-atom neighbour count within 10 A of residue centroid (module only)
xyz=np.stack([at["x"],at["y"],at["z"]],1).astype(float)
res=np.unique(at["resi"])
cent={int(r):xyz[at["resi"]==r].mean(0) for r in res}
bur={r:int(((np.linalg.norm(xyz-c,axis=1)<10).sum())) for r,c in cent.items()}

rows=[]
for r in res:
    i=int(r)-1
    rows.append(dict(resi=int(r), aa=ref[i], lining=int(r) in lining, burial=bur[int(r)],
                     ident=ident[i], hydfrac=hydfrac[i], entropy=ent[i], cov=cov[i],
                     is_hydrophobic=ref[i] in HYD))
t=pd.DataFrame(rows)
t.to_csv("nvj3_conservation_per_residue.csv",index=False)
print(t.groupby("lining")[["ident","hydfrac","entropy","burial"]].mean().round(3).to_string())

def cmp(col, label, sub=None):
    d=t if sub is None else sub
    a=d[d.lining][col]; b=d[~d.lining][col]
    u,p=stats.mannwhitneyu(a,b,alternative="greater")
    r=2*u/(len(a)*len(b))-1
    print(f"  {label}: lining median={a.median():.3f} (n={len(a)}) vs non-lining {b.median():.3f} (n={len(b)}), p={p:.2g}, rank-biserial={r:+.2f}")

print("\nAll PXA-module residues (61-253):")
for c,l in [("ident","sequence identity"),("hydfrac","hydrophobic-residue frequency"),("burial","burial (neighbour count)")]:
    cmp(c,l)
print("  entropy (lower = more conserved):", end=" ")
a=t[t.lining].entropy; b=t[~t.lining].entropy
u,p=stats.mannwhitneyu(a,b,alternative="less"); print(f"lining {a.median():.2f} vs {b.median():.2f}, p={p:.2g}")

# burial-matched comparison: restrict to buried residues only
thr=np.median(t.burial)
sub=t[t.burial>=thr]
print(f"\nBurial-matched (neighbour count >= median {thr:.0f}), n={len(sub)}:")
for c,l in [("ident","sequence identity"),("hydfrac","hydrophobic-residue frequency")]:
    cmp(c,l,sub)
a=sub[sub.lining].burial; b=sub[~sub.lining].burial
print(f"  burial check: lining median={a.median():.0f} vs non-lining {b.median():.0f} (MW p={stats.mannwhitneyu(a,b).pvalue:.2g})")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(15,4.5))
for i,(c,lab) in enumerate([("ident","per-position sequence identity"),("hydfrac","frequency of hydrophobic residue"),("entropy","Shannon entropy (bits)")]):
    data=[t[t.lining][c],t[~t.lining][c]]
    ax[i].boxplot(data,labels=["cavity-lining","other PXA-module"],showfliers=False)
    for j,d in enumerate(data):
        ax[i].scatter(np.random.default_rng(j).normal(j+1,0.06,len(d)),d,s=12,alpha=0.5,
                      color="#c0392b" if j==0 else "#7f8c8d")
    ax[i].set_title(lab,fontsize=10); ax[i].grid(axis="y",alpha=0.3)
plt.suptitle(f"Nvj3 (Q03983) PXA module 61-253: conservation across {K} fungal PXA-only orthologs")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
